notes.heading: Disposition and Use of Assets
notes.text: Pub. L. 107–171, title VI, § 6201(b), (c), May 13, 2002, 116 Stat. 418, 419, provided that: “(b) Disposition of Assets.—On the date of enactment of this Act [May 13, 2002]—“(1) the assets, both tangible and intangible, of the Alternative Agricultural Research and Commercialization Corporation (referred to in this section as the ‘Corporation’), including the funds in the Alternative Agricultural Research and Commercialization Revolving Fund as of the date of enactment of this Act, are transferred to the Secretary of Agriculture; and “(2) notwithstanding the Federal Property and Administrative Services Act of 1949 (40 U.S.C. 471 et seq.)
